machine_leads.origin_basis: Manufacturer states machines are manufactured in the UK; Hypertherm plasma equipment is made in the USA and Hammelmann waterjet pumps in Germany. The offered machine and configuration still need confirmation.
machine_leads.published_limits_basis: Use the specific XP brochure's 32 mm thickness, not inconsistent 40 mm headline marketing. Published values are screening evidence, not offered capacity or precision acceptance.

machine_leads.origin_basis: Manufacturer plate datasheet identifies Dalzell plate production and S355 grades. Historical catalogue establishes a UK plate route lead only, not current availability, UK melt origin, required dimensions or a certified order.

Manufacturer identifies in-house tooling and accessories at Sheringham, Norfolk and UK-made steelworkers. Exact offered machine origin must be confirmed; CNC controls are stated to come from sister company Robosoft in Belgium.
machine_leads.use: Secondary plate/fixture tooling lead; no punching substitution for finished fatigue-critical bolt holes is approved.

machine_leads.origin_basis: Manufacturer describes Greater Manchester production by hot forging, cold forming, machining and threading, with metric coarse/fine M6-M64 capability. This supports a UK manufacturing route lead, not M27 stock, rail qualification or a confirmed offered grade/geometry/origin.

sequence: Obtain certified stock/heat trace and accepted drawings; dry nest to verify sheet footprint and total bed load.
Profile segmented plates on UK-manufactured XP4000 lead only where dimensions pass; leave 3mm finish allowance at datum/bolt interfaces.
Prepare and qualify transverse butt joints; join long strips with controlled sequence before I/box assembly. Inspect every research splice before closing box.
Assemble on proposed 20m datum fixture; fit centre-box internal diaphragms before closing top. Weld opposite seams in a balanced sequence and record distortion.
Fit side stiffener halves and transverse bolsters; keep pad interfaces as machining allowance until weld inspection and dimensional survey.

Machine pads to common datum A with portable milling/boring process whose machine, reach and capacity are still unspecified; drill/ream bolt holes from datums B/C. Plasma holes are not accepted finished fatigue holes.
Inspect welds by an approved VT/MT/UT plan, measure complete frame datums, trial fit bogie mating parts, conduct approved proof/fatigue/first-article programme before release.

sequence: Obtain certified stock/heat trace and accepted drawings; dry nest to verify sheet footprint and total bed load.
Profile segmented plates on UK-manufactured XP4000 lead only where dimensions pass; leave 3mm finish allowance at datum/bolt interfaces.
Prepare and qualify transverse butt joints; join long strips with controlled sequence before I/box assembly. Inspect every research splice before closing box.
Assemble on proposed 20m datum fixture; fit centre-box internal diaphragms before closing top. Weld opposite seams in a balanced sequence and record distortion.
Fit side stiffener halves and transverse bolsters; keep pad interfaces as machining allowance until weld inspection and dimensional survey.

Machine pads to common datum A with portable milling/boring process whose machine, reach and capacity are still unspecified; drill/ream bolt holes from datums B/C. Plasma holes are not accepted finished fatigue holes.
Inspect welds by an approved VT/MT/UT plan, measure complete frame datums, trial fit bogie mating parts, conduct approved proof/fatigue/first-article programme before release.
